qs.q: A 28-year-old pregnant patient notices rapid enlargement of a known breast fibroadenoma. What is the most appropriate initial management approach?
qs.e: Fibroadenomas are hormonally responsive and can grow rapidly during pregnancy, mimicking cancer but requiring no aggressive intervention. Reassurance prevents unnecessary panic or invasive procedures.
